findings.title: resources.xg4ken.com is neutral in the bounded mobile Store Locator control
findings.claim: Blocking the naturally requested resources.xg4ken.com script leaves the mobile Store Locator meaningful and visually identical in all three fresh contexts, with no generic application error and exact recovery.

causal_memory.state_scope: resources.xg4ken.com script availability and visible Store Locator behavior
causal_memory.time_scope: 3/3 baseline, exact-host block, and recovery contexts on 2026-07-19

user_control.user_effect: No bounded user-control degradation was observed; three inputs, one main landmark, text, screenshot, and accessibility-node counts remained identical.

findings.minimal_fix: No product fix is proposed for this host from the bounded evidence; preserve it as a neutral control and do not group it with the Maps dependency.
findings.regression_test: In three fresh mobile Store Locator contexts, block resources.xg4ken.com and assert natural host presence, exact block count, meaningful route identity, three visible inputs, no generic app error, and unchanged visible-state hashes.

findings.title: Blocking resources.xg4ken.com does not independently reproduce the Store Locator crash
findings.surface: mobile public Store Locator exact-host treatment
findings.claim: Blocking resources.xg4ken.com independently causes the mobile Store Locator generic application crash.

causal_memory.time_scope: three fresh exact-host treatment contexts on 2026-07-19

user_control.user_effect: No user-control loss is assigned because the Store Locator remained meaningful and identical during every treatment.

findings.minimal_fix: Preserve this rejected hypothesis as negative causal memory and attribute the confirmed grouped failure only to dependencies that reproduce it independently.
